shared_elements: human figure represented in stone carving
low-relief surface motifs on a body
justification: Both depict the human form and both include disc/ring-like motifs on the body or costume, but A is a shallow relief frieze of a procession of many slender figures in profile, robed and holding staffs and vessels, interacting with one another, while B is a single massive frontal figure carved nearly in the round with a broad head, incised brow and abstract raised bosses on its torso. Beyond the universal fact of representing people, there is no shared posture, attribute, grouping or ordering, and the depictive conventions (delicate naturalistic profile relief vs. blocky frontal monolith with schematic ornaments) are quite different.
